basic_details.scholarship_name: Ernst Ludwig Ehrlich Studienwerk (ELES) International Doctoral & Graduate Scholarships
basic_details.offering_entity: Ernst Ludwig Ehrlich Studienwerk (ELES) & German Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: State-accredited German Universities and Technical Universities (TU9 & Flagship Universities across Germany)
basic_details.major_restrictions: All academic disciplines: Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Medicine, Humanities, Social Sciences, Law, and Economics.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~80 to 120 doctoral and graduate scholarships awarded annually across Germany
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open internationally; typically 2 to 5 international scholars demonstrating extraordinary academic achievement and interfaith/intercultural dialogue engagement selected annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 36 months (3 years) for PhD; up to 24 months (2 years) for Master's
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: Monthly tax-free living stipend of €1,450 / month for PhD (~PKR 435,000 / month) plus €100 / month research allowance; €934 / month for Master's (~PKR 280,200 / month) plus healthcare subsidies, family allowances, and tuition-free German university education

nationality_requirements: Open to German citizens, EU nationals, and international applicants of all nationalities including Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No strict statutory age limit; applicants should be in the early stages of their doctoral or graduate studies.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed recognized 18-year Master's degree (for PhD) or recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree (for Master's) with above-average academic performance (minimum German grade 2.0 or equivalent to CGPA 3.30+/4.00) from an HEC-recognized institution.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: German grading scale minimum 2.0 (gut) or CGPA 3.30 / 4.00; competitive candidates typically hold CGPA >= 3.60 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Open to all disciplines: engineering, computer science, medicine, natural sciences, humanities, or social sciences.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Enrolled or accepted for study/doctoral research at a recognized German university.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Documented commitment to civil society, intercultural dialogue, democratic values, or community engagement is a key pillar of assessment.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 or TOEFL iBT minimum 85 for English-medium programs; German language proficiency (CEFR B2/C1) required for German-medium programs and foundation seminars.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Conversational German (B1/B2) strongly encouraged to actively participate in foundation colloquia and community events.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to all qualified applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: ELES is one of Germany's 13 official Begabtenförderungswerke funded by the BMBF; open to Jewish scholars as well as non-Jewish candidates dedicated to interfaith dialogue and minority rights.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another parallel scholarship from German Begabtenförderungswerke (e.g. DAAD, FES, KAS) covering identical costs.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee covered; German public universities charge zero tuition fees for doctoral researchers.

admission_application_fee.details: Applying to ELES is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Subsidized student residence hall apartments through Studierendenwerk (approx. €280 to €450 / month), paid easily from living stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living stipend: €1,450 / month for PhD (~PKR 435,000 / month) plus €100 / month research allowance (€1,550 total); €934 / month for Master's (~PKR 280,200 / month).

airfare.details: Relocation travel between Pakistan and Germany is self-funded by the student.

visa_fee.details: German National Student Visa fee (€75 / ~PKR 23,000) paid at German Embassy in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi.

health_insurance.details: Health and nursing care insurance subsidy of up to €100 / month provided to doctoral scholarship recipients.
health_insurance.amount: Up to €100 / month health insurance subsidy

food_allowance.details: Subsidized campus dining halls (Mensa) across German universities; daily meals cost €3 to €6.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Dedicated monthly research cost allowance (Forschungskostenpauschale) of €100 / month, plus full access to university libraries and digital databases.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Travel and conference grants available for international academic research and presentations.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Semester ticket (Deutschlandticket integration) providing free public regional rail and urban transit across Germany.
travel_transit_allowance.amount: Free regional & urban transit via semester ticket

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple host institutions (any recognized public university or research institute in Germany).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: All top-tier German universities; open to all disciplines in STEM, social sciences, humanities, and medicine.
available_majors: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence
PhD in Electrical Engineering and Information Technology
PhD in Physics and Quantum Materials
PhD in Biomedical Sciences and Biotechnology
PhD in Sustainable Energy and Environmental Engineering
PhD in Sociology, Philosophy, and Intercultural Studies
MSc / MA across all recognized university fields
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master's: 2 years; PhD: 3 years (extensible to 4 years)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Master's degree with German grade 2.0+ (CGPA >= 3.30/4.00), doctoral supervision confirmation (Betreuungszusage) from a German university professor, research exposé (8-10 pages), two academic letters of recommendation, and documented social/civic engagement record.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Securing an official doctoral supervision confirmation (Betreuungszusage) from a German university professor is the essential prerequisite before submitting the ELES scholarship application.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Articulate a clear rationale connecting your research excellence with broader societal, interfaith, or intercultural understanding.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Secure supervision confirmation from German professor, register on ELES application portal during bi-annual intake, upload research exposé, CV, transcripts, and proof of civic engagement, and register academic referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Secure doctoral supervision commitment (Betreuungszusage) from a full professor at an accredited German university.
Step 2: Draft comprehensive 8 to 10-page research proposal (Exposé) detailing methodology, timeline, and scholarly contributions.
Step 3: Register on ELES online application portal during open call (by March 1 or September 1).
Step 4: Upload attested transcripts, CV, exposé, and documentation of socio-political/civic commitment.
Step 5: Academic referees submit formal confidential appraisals directly.
Step 6: Preliminary committee screening and review by external expert reviewers (Fachgutachter).
Step 7: Shortlisted candidates invited for personal/virtual selection interview (Auswahlgespräch).
Step 8: Final award decision announced in July (for October start) or January (for April start).
Step 9: Apply for German National Visa and matriculate at host university.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Separate Routing: Candidates must first secure admission/supervision at a German university, then apply independently to ELES for fellowship funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted directly by two academic professors (one must be the doctoral supervisor) using official ELES evaluation forms.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Detailed essay outlining personal trajectory, motivation, civic engagement, interfaith dialogue, and societal responsibility.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Exhaustive research proposal (8 to 10 pages) outlining research question, state of research, theoretical framework, methodology, and 3-year work plan.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Complete tabular academic CV in German or English detailing education, publications, employment, and social/civic activities.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Rigorous selection interview conducted by an ELES selection committee panel comprising university professors, community leaders, and foundation staff.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 85+ for English doctoral programs; German language proof if applicable.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified true copies of transcripts and degree certificates; HEC and MoFA attestations required for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified German or English translation for all non-German/non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via ELES application portal.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: March 1 (for October award) / September 1 (for April award)
important_dates_timeline.university_admission_deadline: Concurrent with or prior to ELES submission
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Bi-annual application cycles: March 1 deadline for autumn entry and September 1 deadline for spring entry.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Prior academic grades, honors, course rigor, and scholarly feasibility)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 30% (Demonstrated civic engagement, commitment to intercultural/interfaith dialogue, and democratic values)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 20% (Scientific originality, theoretical rigor, and feasibility of the doctoral exposé)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Professional practice in research, technical, or community leadership)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 5% (Clarity of personal trajectory and democratic conviction)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 0% (Interview is decisive binary pass/fail for shortlisted candidates)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: ELES Selection Board comprising university professors, community leaders, and foundation alumni.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-tier holistic evaluation assessing scientific excellence, research feasibility, and authentic intercultural commitment.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~600 to 900 applicants nationwide across both cycles
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~8% to 12% for candidates with strong professor supervision backing and documented interfaith/dialogue engagement
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Master's German grade <= 1.8 (CGPA >= 3.50/4.00), accompanied by proven civic, dialogue, or community leadership
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Scholars across STEM, social sciences, or humanities with strong research records and active dedication to democratic dialogue.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from top Pakistani institutions (LUMS, NUST, Quaid-i-Azam, FAST-NUCES, UET Lahore).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Germany, Pakistan, Israel, Ukraine, United States, France, India, Brazil.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official portal eles-studienwerk.de.
ELES never charges application fees or endorses commercial educational consultants.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying for ELES scholarships is 100% free of charge.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agency written statements are disqualified; the foundation rigorously probes personal civic commitment during selection interviews.
hidden_costs_breakdown: HEC and MoFA document attestations in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000 to 25,000.
Initial living deposit before first stipend payment: ~€500 (~PKR 150,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Only Jewish students can apply. Reality: Non-Jewish scholars actively engaged in interfaith dialogue, minority rights, or intercultural exchange are welcomed and regularly funded.
Myth: You must study Jewish studies. Reality: Scholars in all fields (AI, engineering, physics, medicine, economics) are eligible and supported.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial portals claim ELES requires German fluency for all majors; in reality, doctoral research conducted in English is fully eligible if supervisor supports it.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain satisfactory doctoral research progress and submit annual dissertation progress reports endorsed by supervisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Active participation in the Foundation's ideational support program (ideelle Förderung), including mandatory attendance at annual foundation colloquia and regional seminars.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress report submitted to the Foundation's Department of Educational Support.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time academic work (e.g. teaching assistantship up to 10 hours/week) permitted with foundation approval; commercial employment strictly restricted.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; zero service bond or return obligation (scholars may pursue international careers or postdocs globally).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Termination of fellowship if doctoral candidate abandons studies without valid grounds or fails annual review.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Permitted across German universities with foundation approval and supervisor transition.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Topic changes require formal approval from supervisor and foundation committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Standard tenure is 36 months; a 6 to 12-month extension may be granted upon application for final thesis completion.
